items.title: This ER Doctor Became a Hospital’s First Clinical AI Engineer
items.excerpt: When Boston Children’s Hospital posted a job listing for a prompt engineer in 2023, Dinesh Rai decided to apply. He didn’t expect to get the job. At the time, prompt engineering was being touted as one of the hot new jobs created by generative AI. Companies wanted people who knew how to coax the best answers from large language models (LLMs) by carefully wording instructions, supplying examples, and giving the systems personas or other context. items.excerpt: Release: datasette-charts 0.4a0 The new datasette-charts plugin has its own plugin hook to allow other plugins to define new chart types, but I hadn't actually used it for anything yet. I had Claude Opus 5.5 build an experimental plugins just to try out the hook and it came up with a bunch of friction points in the design. This release addresses those, which should make building additional chart plugins a whole lot more ergonomic. I've also added a website for the plugin, at charts.datasette.io

items.title: Tiny Hat: a new Linux distro dedicated to retro gamedev

It comes with a few small games, an easy way to install and run more games and several example programs for getting into retro game development. It also uses a modern stack of libraries, with dwl / Wayland, SDL3 and GTK4.
